# Hongdi Food Machinery

This website belongs to a poultry dehairing machine and food processing equipment manufacturer in Jieyang, Guangdong, China. It provides bilingual Chinese and English information for poultry dehairing machines, scalding-dehairing integrated machines, food processing equipment, and practical equipment selection advice.

- Company Introduction: https://hongdi-food-machinery.vercel.app/en/about/

- Solutions: https://hongdi-food-machinery.vercel.app/en/solutions/
- FAQ: https://hongdi-food-machinery.vercel.app/en/faqs/
- Articles: https://hongdi-food-machinery.vercel.app/en/articles/
- Chinese Home: https://hongdi-food-machinery.vercel.app/zh/
